references.phrase: n in natural numbers including zero
finite product from j=0 to n−1
references.context: Exactly n real factors (x−j), indexed by integers j from 0 to n−1.
Product of zero factors equals multiplicative identity 1 when n=0.

references.disposition: Decrementing factors differ from repeated multiplication of x by itself.

review_rationale: Read falling factorial as product of n consecutive decremented real factors, including the n=0 empty-product convention and nonnegative integer input.
